// Generated from the estate's JCL. Rewritten on every run; do not edit.
#nullable enable
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace {{Namespace}}
{
    // A program a JCL step runs, by EXEC PGM= or by RUN PROGRAM under the TSO monitor.
    public interface IBatchProgram
    {
        // The program name the JCL uses.
        string ProgramId { get; }

        // Returns the program's RETURN-CODE. Throwing ends the step as an abend; throw
        // BatchAbendException to give the abend a code.
        Task<int> RunAsync(BatchStepContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }

    public enum JclCompare { Gt, Lt, Eq, Ne, Ge, Le }

    public enum JclStepKind { Program, Tso, Utility, Unresolved }

    public sealed record JclDd(string Name)
    {
        public string? Dataset { get; init; }
        public string? Member { get; init; }
        public string? Generation { get; init; }
        public bool Temporary { get; init; }
        public string? Status { get; init; }
        public string? NormalDisposition { get; init; }
        public string? AbnormalDisposition { get; init; }
        public string? SysOut { get; init; }
        public bool Dummy { get; init; }
        public IReadOnlyList<string>? InStream { get; init; }
        public IReadOnlyList<JclDd> Concatenated { get; init; } = [];
    }

    public sealed record JclDb2Run(string Program, string? Plan, string? Subsystem, string? Parms);

    // Bypass the step when Code Op (a step's return code) is true.
    public sealed record JclCondTest(int Code, JclCompare Op, string? Step = null);

    public sealed record JclCond(IReadOnlyList<JclCondTest> Tests, bool Even = false, bool Only = false);

    public sealed record JclStepDefinition(string Name, JclStepKind Kind)
    {
        public string? Program { get; init; }
        public string? Procedure { get; init; }
        public string? Parm { get; init; }
        public IReadOnlyList<JclDb2Run> Runs { get; init; } = [];
        public Func<JclJobState, bool>? Guard { get; init; }
        public bool GuardTestsAbend { get; init; }
        public string? GuardError { get; init; }
        public JclCond? Cond { get; init; }
        public IReadOnlyList<JclDd> Dds { get; init; } = [];
        public IReadOnlyList<string> ControlStatements { get; init; } = [];
    }

    public abstract class JclJob
    {
        protected JclJob(string name, JclCond? cond = null)
        {
            Name = name;
            Cond = cond;
        }

        public string Name { get; }
        public JclCond? Cond { get; }
        public abstract IReadOnlyList<JclStepDefinition> Steps { get; }
    }

    // Ends a step as an abend with a code such as U0100 or S0C7.
    public sealed class BatchAbendException(string code, string message, Exception? inner = null) : Exception(message, inner)
    {
        public string Code { get; } = code;
    }

    // The job cannot go on as written: a procedure missing from the source, a condition that could
    // not be read, or a utility with no equivalent. Not an abend; nothing a later step can test.
    public sealed class JclStepNotRunnableException(string message, Exception? inner = null) : Exception(message, inner);

    public sealed record JclStepOutcome(string Step, bool Ran, int? ReturnCode, string? AbendCode, bool Abended, string? Message);

    public sealed record JclJobResult(string Job, string RunId, IReadOnlyList<JclStepOutcome> Steps, bool Terminated)
    {
        public int MaxReturnCode => Steps.Where(s => s.ReturnCode.HasValue).Select(s => s.ReturnCode!.Value).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max();
        public bool Abended => Steps.Any(s => s.Abended);
    }

    // What the steps run so far did, as IF and COND read it. A step that abended or did not run has
    // no return code, so every comparison with it is false.
    public sealed class JclJobState
    {
        private readonly List<JclStepOutcome> _outcomes = [];

        public IReadOnlyList<JclStepOutcome> Outcomes => _outcomes;
        public bool AnyAbend => _outcomes.Any(o => o.Abended);

        internal void Add(JclStepOutcome outcome) => _outcomes.Add(outcome);

        // A name that called a procedure stands for all of its steps.
        public IEnumerable<JclStepOutcome> Matching(string? step) => step is null
            ? _outcomes
            : _outcomes.Where(o => o.Step.Equals(step, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                                   || o.Step.StartsWith(step + ".", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        public bool Rc(string? step, JclCompare op, int value)
        {
            var codes = Matching(step).Where(o => o.Ran && !o.Abended && o.ReturnCode.HasValue).Select(o => o.ReturnCode!.Value).ToList();
            return codes.Count > 0 && Compare(codes.Max(), op, value);
        }

        public bool AbendCc(string? step, JclCompare op, string code)
        {
            var wanted = NormalizeAbend(code);
            var codes = Matching(step).Where(o => o.Abended && o.AbendCode is not null).Select(o => NormalizeAbend(o.AbendCode!)).ToList();
            if (codes.Count == 0) return false;
            return op == JclCompare.Ne ? codes.All(c => c != wanted) : codes.Any(c => c == wanted);
        }

        public bool Abended(string? step) => Matching(step).Any(o => o.Abended);

        public bool Ran(string step) => Matching(step).Any(o => o.Ran);

        public static bool Compare(int left, JclCompare op, int right) => op switch
        {
            JclCompare.Gt => left > right,
            JclCompare.Lt => left < right,
            JclCompare.Eq => left == right,
            JclCompare.Ne => left != right,
            JclCompare.Ge => left >= right,
            JclCompare.Le => left <= right,
            _ => false,
        };

        private static string NormalizeAbend(string code)
        {
            var c = code.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
            return c.StartsWith('U') && int.TryParse(c[1..], out var user) ? "U" + user.ToString("D4") : c;
        }
    }

    public interface IDatasetCatalog
    {
        // A run keeps relative generations fixed, as a mainframe job does.
        string Resolve(string runId, JclDd dd);
        string SysOutPath(string runId, string job, string step, string dd);
        void Delete(string runId, JclDd dd);
        void EndJob(string runId);
    }

    // Datasets as files under one root: A.B.C is <root>/A.B.C, a member is a file inside it, and a
    // generation data group is a directory of G0001V00, G0002V00, ...
    public sealed class DirectoryDatasetCatalog : IDatasetCatalog
    {
        private static readonly Regex GenerationFile = new(@"^G(\d{4})V00$", RegexOptions.Compiled);
        private readonly string _root;
        private readonly Dictionary<(string Run, string Base), int> _current = new();
        private readonly object _lock = new();

        public DirectoryDatasetCatalog(string root) => _root = Path.GetFullPath(root);

        public string Resolve(string runId, JclDd dd)
        {
            if (dd.Dataset is null) throw new InvalidOperationException($"DD {dd.Name} names no dataset.");
            if (dd.Temporary) return Under(Path.Join(_root, ".temp", runId, Name(dd.Dataset.TrimStart('&'))));
            var path = Path.Join(_root, Name(dd.Dataset));
            if (dd.Generation is { } generation) path = Path.Join(path, Generation(runId, dd.Dataset, path, generation));
            if (dd.Member is { } member) path = Path.Join(path, Name(member));
            return Under(path);
        }

        public string SysOutPath(string runId, string job, string step, string dd) =>
            Under(Path.Join(_root, ".sysout", Name(job), runId, Name(step) + "." + Name(dd) + ".txt"));

        public void Delete(string runId, JclDd dd)
        {
            var path = Resolve(runId, dd);
            if (Directory.Exists(path)) Directory.Delete(path, recursive: true);
            else if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path);
        }

        public void EndJob(string runId)
        {
            var temp = Path.Join(_root, ".temp", runId);
            if (Directory.Exists(temp)) Directory.Delete(temp, recursive: true);
            lock (_lock)
                foreach (var key in _current.Keys.Where(k => k.Run == runId).ToList()) _current.Remove(key);
        }

        private string Generation(string runId, string name, string directory, string relative)
        {
            int current;
            lock (_lock)
            {
                if (!_current.TryGetValue((runId, name), out current))
                {
                    current = Directory.Exists(directory)
                        ? Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory).Select(f => GenerationFile.Match(Path.GetFileName(f)))
                            .Where(m => m.Success).Select(m => int.Parse(m.Groups[1].Value)).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()
                        : 0;
                    _current[(runId, name)] = current;
                }
            }
            var number = current + int.Parse(relative);
            if (number < 1) throw new FileNotFoundException($"{name}({relative}) does not exist: the group has {current} generation(s).");
            return $"G{number:D4}V00";
        }

        // A name must stay one entry under the root: an empty one, or one of dots alone, would
        // resolve to the root or its parent, which a DELETE would then remove.
        private static string Name(string name)
        {
            var safe = Regex.Replace(name, @"[^A-Za-z0-9.$#@_-]", "_");
            if (safe.Trim('.').Length == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException($"'{name}' is not a usable dataset name.");
            return safe;
        }

        private string Under(string path)
        {
            var full = Path.GetFullPath(path);
            if (!full.StartsWith(_root + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"{path} is outside the dataset root {_root}.");
            return full;
        }
    }

    public sealed class BatchStepContext
    {
        private readonly IDatasetCatalog _datasets;
        private readonly string _runId;

        public BatchStepContext(string job, string step, string runId, string? programId, string? parm,
            JclDb2Run? db2, IReadOnlyList<JclDd> dds, IReadOnlyList<string> controlStatements, IDatasetCatalog datasets)
        {
            Job = job;
            Step = step;
            _runId = runId;
            ProgramId = programId;
            Parm = parm;
            Db2Plan = db2?.Plan;
            Db2Subsystem = db2?.Subsystem;
            Dds = dds.GroupBy(d => d.Name.Split('.')[^1], StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Last(), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            ControlStatements = controlStatements;
            _datasets = datasets;
        }

        public string Job { get; }
        public string Step { get; }
        public string? ProgramId { get; }
        public string? Parm { get; }
        public string? Db2Plan { get; }
        public string? Db2Subsystem { get; }
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, JclDd> Dds { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<string> ControlStatements { get; }

        public bool Has(string dd) => Dds.ContainsKey(dd);

        public JclDd Dd(string dd) => Dds.TryGetValue(dd, out var found)
            ? found
            : throw new InvalidOperationException($"Step {Step} of {Job} has no DD {dd}.");

        // The file behind a DD; null when it is DUMMY or in-stream.
        public string? PathFor(string dd) => PathFor(Dd(dd));

        public string ResolveDataset(string name) => _datasets.Resolve(_runId, new JclDd("") { Dataset = name });

        public IReadOnlyList<string> InStream(string dd) => Dd(dd).InStream ?? [];

        public Stream OpenRead(string dd)
        {
            var first = Dd(dd);
            var parts = new List<Stream>();
            try
            {
                foreach (var part in first.Concatenated.Prepend(first)) parts.Add(OpenOne(part));
            }
            catch
            {
                foreach (var opened in parts) opened.Dispose();
                throw;
            }
            return parts.Count == 1 ? parts[0] : new ConcatenatedStream(parts);
        }

        public Stream OpenWrite(string dd)
        {
            var target = Dd(dd);
            if (target.Dummy) return Stream.Null;
            var path = PathFor(target) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"DD {dd} of step {Step} is in-stream and cannot be written.");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)!);
            return new FileStream(path, target.Status == "MOD" || target.SysOut is not null ? FileMode.Append : FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
        }

        internal string? PathFor(JclDd dd)
        {
            if (dd.Dummy || dd.InStream is not null) return null;
            if (dd.SysOut is not null) return _datasets.SysOutPath(_runId, Job, Step, dd.Name);
            return dd.Dataset is null ? null : _datasets.Resolve(_runId, dd);
        }

        private Stream OpenOne(JclDd dd)
        {
            if (dd.Dummy) return Stream.Null;
            if (dd.InStream is { } lines) return new MemoryStream(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(string.Concat(lines.Select(l => l + "\n"))));
            var path = PathFor(dd) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"DD {dd.Name} of step {Step} has nothing to read.");
            return File.OpenRead(path);
        }

        private sealed class ConcatenatedStream(IReadOnlyList<Stream> parts) : Stream
        {
            private int _index;

            public override bool CanRead => true;
            public override bool CanSeek => false;
            public override bool CanWrite => false;
            public override long Length => throw new NotSupportedException();
            public override long Position { get => throw new NotSupportedException(); set => throw new NotSupportedException(); }

            public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)
            {
                while (_index < parts.Count)
                {
                    var read = parts[_index].Read(buffer, offset, count);
                    if (read > 0) return read;
                    _index++;
                }
                return 0;
            }

            public override void Flush() { }
            public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) => throw new NotSupportedException();
            public override void SetLength(long value) => throw new NotSupportedException();
            public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => throw new NotSupportedException();

            protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
            {
                if (disposing) foreach (var part in parts) part.Dispose();
                base.Dispose(disposing);
            }
        }
    }

    public interface IJobUtilities
    {
        Task<int> RunAsync(string program, BatchStepContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    }

    // IEFBR14 and the IDCAMS commands that act on files: DELETE, REPRO, DEFINE and SET. Anything else
    // stops the job and names the utility, rather than pretending to have run it.
    public class DefaultJobUtilities : IJobUtilities
    {
        private static readonly Regex Keyword = new(@"\b(?<key>[A-Z]+)\s*\(\s*(?<value>[^()]*)\)", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);

        public virtual Task<int> RunAsync(string program, BatchStepContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) =>
            program.ToUpperInvariant() switch
            {
                "IEFBR14" => Task.FromResult(0),
                "IDCAMS" => Task.FromResult(Idcams(context)),
                _ => throw new JclStepNotRunnableException(
                    $"Step {context.Step} runs {program}, which has no generated equivalent. Implement IJobUtilities for it; "
                    + "its control statements are in BatchStepContext.ControlStatements."),
            };

        private static int Idcams(BatchStepContext context)
        {
            int maxcc = 0, lastcc = 0;
            foreach (var command in Commands(context.ControlStatements))
            {
                var verb = command.Split(' ', 2)[0].ToUpperInvariant();
                var rest = command.Length > verb.Length ? command[verb.Length..].Trim() : "";
                switch (verb)
                {
                    case "DELETE" or "DEL":
                        // DELETE ( A.B.C ) PURGE: the entry is the first word that is not a parenthesis.
                        var name = rest.Split([' ', '(', ')'], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).FirstOrDefault()?.Trim('\'') ?? "";
                        if (name.Length == 0) throw new JclStepNotRunnableException($"Step {context.Step}: IDCAMS {command} names no entry.");
                        var path = context.ResolveDataset(name);
                        if (Directory.Exists(path)) { Directory.Delete(path, true); lastcc = 0; }
                        else if (File.Exists(path)) { File.Delete(path); lastcc = 0; }
                        else lastcc = 8;
                        break;
                    case "REPRO":
                        var arguments = Arguments(rest);
                        using (var input = arguments.TryGetValue("INFILE", out var inDd) ? context.OpenRead(inDd)
                                   : File.OpenRead(context.ResolveDataset(Required(arguments, "INDATASET", "IDS"))))
                        using (var output = arguments.TryGetValue("OUTFILE", out var outDd) ? context.OpenWrite(outDd)
                                   : Create(context.ResolveDataset(Required(arguments, "OUTDATASET", "ODS"))))
                            input.CopyTo(output);
                        lastcc = 0;
                        break;
                    case "DEFINE" or "DEF":
                        var defined = Arguments(rest).GetValueOrDefault("NAME")
                            ?? throw new JclStepNotRunnableException($"Step {context.Step}: DEFINE without NAME: {command}");
                        var target = context.ResolveDataset(defined);
                        if (rest.StartsWith("GDG", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) Directory.CreateDirectory(target);
                        else if (!File.Exists(target)) Create(target).Dispose();
                        lastcc = 0;
                        break;
                    case "SET":
                        var assignment = Regex.Match(rest, @"^(?<cc>MAXCC|LASTCC)\s*=\s*(?<value>\d+)$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
                        if (!assignment.Success) throw new JclStepNotRunnableException($"Step {context.Step}: IDCAMS {command} is not supported.");
                        var value = int.Parse(assignment.Groups["value"].Value);
                        if (assignment.Groups["cc"].Value.Equals("MAXCC", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { maxcc = value; continue; }
                        lastcc = value;
                        break;
                    default:
                        throw new JclStepNotRunnableException($"Step {context.Step}: IDCAMS {verb} has no generated equivalent.");
                }
                maxcc = Math.Max(maxcc, lastcc);
            }
            return maxcc;
        }

        private static FileStream Create(string path)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)!);
            return File.Create(path);
        }

        private static string Required(Dictionary<string, string> arguments, params string[] keys) =>
            keys.Select(arguments.GetValueOrDefault).FirstOrDefault(v => v is not null)
            ?? throw new JclStepNotRunnableException($"REPRO needs {string.Join(" or ", keys)}.");

        private static Dictionary<string, string> Arguments(string text) =>
            Keyword.Matches(text).GroupBy(m => m.Groups["key"].Value.ToUpperInvariant())
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.First().Groups["value"].Value.Trim().Trim('\''));

        // A trailing '-' or '+' continues a command; /* ... */ is a comment.
        private static IEnumerable<string> Commands(IEnumerable<string> lines)
        {
            var current = new StringBuilder();
            foreach (var line in lines.Select(l => Regex.Replace(l, @"/\*.*?\*/", " ").Trim()).Where(l => l.Length > 0))
            {
                var continued = line.EndsWith('-') || line.EndsWith('+');
                if (current.Length > 0) current.Append(' ');
                current.Append(continued ? line[..^1].TrimEnd() : line);
                if (continued) continue;
                yield return current.ToString();
                current.Clear();
            }
            if (current.Length > 0) yield return current.ToString();
        }
    }

    // Runs a job the way z/OS does: IF/THEN/ELSE and COND decide each step, JOB COND ends the job,
    // and after an abend only steps that ask for it (COND=EVEN/ONLY, or IF testing ABEND) run.
    public sealed class JclJobRunner
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<string, IBatchProgram> _programs;
        private readonly IDatasetCatalog _datasets;
        private readonly IJobUtilities _utilities;

        public JclJobRunner(IEnumerable<IBatchProgram> programs, IDatasetCatalog datasets, IJobUtilities? utilities = null)
        {
            _programs = new Dictionary<string, IBatchProgram>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var program in programs)
                if (!_programs.TryAdd(program.ProgramId, program))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"Two batch programs have the id {program.ProgramId}.");
            _datasets = datasets;
            _utilities = utilities ?? new DefaultJobUtilities();
        }

        public async Task<JclJobResult> RunAsync(JclJob job, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var runId = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmssfff") + "-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8];
            var state = new JclJobState();
            var terminated = false;
            try
            {
                foreach (var step in job.Steps)
                {
                    cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                    if (terminated || !ShouldRun(step, state))
                    {
                        state.Add(new JclStepOutcome(step.Name, false, null, null, false, terminated ? "JOB COND ended the job" : "bypassed"));
                        continue;
                    }

                    var outcome = await ExecuteAsync(job, step, runId, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    state.Add(outcome);

                    if (!outcome.Abended && outcome.ReturnCode is { } rc && job.Cond is { } jobCond
                        && jobCond.Tests.Any(t => JclJobState.Compare(t.Code, t.Op, rc)))
                        terminated = true;
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                _datasets.EndJob(runId);
            }

            return new JclJobResult(job.Name, runId, state.Outcomes, terminated);
        }

        private static bool ShouldRun(JclStepDefinition step, JclJobState state)
        {
            if (step.GuardError is not null)
                throw new JclStepNotRunnableException($"Step {step.Name}: the condition could not be read: {step.GuardError}");

            var abended = state.AnyAbend;
            if (step.Guard is not null)
            {
                if (!step.Guard(state)) return false;
                if (abended && !step.GuardTestsAbend && step.Cond is not { Even: true } and not { Only: true }) return false;
            }
            else if (abended && step.Cond is not { Even: true } and not { Only: true }) return false;

            if (step.Cond is { } cond)
            {
                if (cond.Only && !abended) return false;
                foreach (var test in cond.Tests)
                {
                    var codes = state.Matching(test.Step).Where(o => o.Ran && !o.Abended && o.ReturnCode.HasValue).Select(o => o.ReturnCode!.Value);
                    if (codes.Any(rc => JclJobState.Compare(test.Code, test.Op, rc))) return false;
                }
            }

            if (step.Kind == JclStepKind.Unresolved)
                throw new JclStepNotRunnableException(
                    $"Step {step.Name} calls procedure {step.Procedure}, which is not in the source. Add it and regenerate the job.");
            return true;
        }

        private async Task<JclStepOutcome> ExecuteAsync(JclJob job, JclStepDefinition step, string runId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            try
            {
                int rc;
                switch (step.Kind)
                {
                    case JclStepKind.Program:
                        rc = await Program(step.Program!).RunAsync(Context(job, step, runId, step.Program, step.Parm, null), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        break;
                    case JclStepKind.Tso:
                        rc = 0;
                        foreach (var run in step.Runs)
                            rc = await Program(run.Program).RunAsync(Context(job, step, runId, run.Program, run.Parms, run), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        break;
                    default:
                        rc = await _utilities.RunAsync(step.Program ?? "", Context(job, step, runId, step.Program, step.Parm, null), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        break;
                }

                Dispose(step, runId, normal: true);
                return new JclStepOutcome(step.Name, true, rc, null, false, null);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not (OperationCanceledException or JclStepNotRunnableException))
            {
                Dispose(step, runId, normal: false);
                return new JclStepOutcome(step.Name, true, null, (ex as BatchAbendException)?.Code, true, ex.Message);
            }
        }

        private IBatchProgram Program(string id) => _programs.TryGetValue(id, out var program)
            ? program
            : throw new BatchAbendException("S806", $"Program {id} was not found: no IBatchProgram has that ProgramId.");

        private BatchStepContext Context(JclJob job, JclStepDefinition step, string runId, string? programId, string? parm, JclDb2Run? db2) =>
            new(job.Name, step.Name, runId, programId, parm, db2, step.Dds, step.ControlStatements, _datasets);

        // A new dataset the step kept exists afterwards even if the step never wrote it, as allocation
        // does; DELETE removes it. Temporary datasets go when the job ends.
        private void Dispose(JclStepDefinition step, string runId, bool normal)
        {
            foreach (var dd in step.Dds.SelectMany(d => d.Concatenated.Prepend(d)).Where(d => d.Dataset is not null && !d.Temporary))
            {
                var disposition = normal ? dd.NormalDisposition : dd.AbnormalDisposition ?? dd.NormalDisposition;
                try
                {
                    if (disposition == "DELETE") { _datasets.Delete(runId, dd); continue; }
                    if (normal && (dd.Status ?? "NEW") == "NEW" && dd.Member is null)
                    {
                        var path = _datasets.Resolve(runId, dd);
                        if (!File.Exists(path) && !Directory.Exists(path))
                        {
                            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)!);
                            File.Create(path).Dispose();
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (!normal && ex is IOException or InvalidOperationException)
                {
                    // Cleanup after an abend must not hide the abend.
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
